subject: HIPAA compliance package: evidence fee vs recurring credit & multi-region discount
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@starlitehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: HIPAA compliance package: evidence fee vs recurring credit & multi-region discount
Attachments: starlite-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Hi Maya — great to speak this morning. Thanks for laying out Starlite's rollout plan and the need for a predictable cost model across US + EU. Per our call, I wanted to put two concrete packaging options on the table so procurement has something to review quickly:

Option A — Upfront evidence & modular add-ons
- One-time evidence/onboarding fee (audit evidence collection + SOC2 attestation support + legal artifact prep): $60,000 one-time.
- Add-ons (recurring): audit logs ingestion & 1yr retention: $2,500/month; KMS seats (fully-managed HSM-backed keys): $1,200/month/seat; EU residency surcharge: $4,500/month/region.
- Benefits: lower recurring run-rate after implementation, predictable scope for our compliance team.

Option B — Amortized credit (no up-front)
- Evidence fee converted to a monthly credit: $5,000/month credit applied against audit logs + residency charges for the first 12 months (equivalent to $60k amortized).
- Slightly higher recurring list rates to cover amortization: audit logs $3,000/month; KMS seat $1,350/month/seat.

Concession path we can consider for a 24-month committed ARR: 12–15% discount on add-ons (higher discount if you commit 36 months). For multi-region deployments (US + EU) we can offer a 10% reduction on the EU residency surcharge provided the commit covers both regions.

Next steps
1) I attached a draft mutual action plan (starlite-MAP-v1.xlsx) — if you can mark procurement milestones we’ll align credits to those dates.
2) If procurement prefers Option B we’ll need a short term-commit (12–24 months) to amortize the credit.
3) If it helps, we can sketch a minimal SOW for evidence deliverables to attach to the commercial terms so legal is comfortable with scope.

Happy to jump on a 30-min sync with Ken and procurement tomorrow if useful.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@starlitehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ken O'Neill <ken.oneill@starlitehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 12:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: HIPAA compliance package: evidence fee vs recurring credit & multi-region discount

Thanks Jordan — good framing. A few clarifying items from procurement/legal before we move to redlines:

1) Split evidence fee: Procurement prefers splitting the evidence/onboarding into two line items: (i) deliverable-based evidence work (what your team will produce) and (ii) escrow/attestation fees (third-party costs). We want to push implementation costs into capex if possible; can Redwood split those and amortize only the implementation work?

2) HSM seats: Our security team wants a cap on incremental seat costs beyond pilot (we expect 5 seats at pilot, 15 at scale). Can you provide a stepped seat rate (e.g., 1–5 seats X, 6–15 seats Y) and an annual seat discount for scale?

3) EU residency: Starlite will require EU hosting for PHI. We need clarity on (a) what the residency surcharge buys (custody vs processing), (b) whether export/transfer logs are included, and (c) if you’ll support a shared KMS across regions or require per-region HSM seats.

4) Discounts and commercial guardrails: Procurement has no issue with an amortized evidence credit, but will expect a minimum committed ARR threshold to get the full 15% concession. What threshold would Redwood require?

Ken CC’d for legal — he will want to see your proposed SOW language around evidence deliverables and acceptance criteria. Can we get an updated price table and a brief SOW attachment?

-Maya
Director of Cloud Ops, Starlite Health
maya.patel@starlitehealth.com | +1 212-555-0142

Subject: Re: HIPAA compliance package: evidence fee vs recurring credit & multi-region discount
Attachments: evidence-fee-schedule.pdf (pdf)

Hi Maya (and Ken) — appreciate the detail. Per your asks, attached is a short evidence breakdown and an updated pricing table — summary below: 

Evidence split proposal (per your request)
- Implementation work (Redwood labor + project mgmt): $40,000 one-time OR amortize as $3,333/month credit over 12 months.
- Third-party attestation & escrow: $20,000 pass-through (billed as a separate line item; no amortization).

HSM seat tiers
- 1–5 seats: $1,200/month/seat
- 6–15 seats: $950/month/seat
- 16+ seats: $750/month/seat
We can layer an additional 8–12% annual scale discount if you commit to a 24–36 month seat ramp schedule (we typically require a minimum committed count for tiered pricing).

EU residency and KMS model
- Residency surcharge covers data segregation, region-specific key custody options, and restricted egress controls. Export/transfer logs are included as part of the audit logs add-on; retention and exportability aligned to the SOW.
- We can support a shared KMS across regions with hybrid custody (customer-managed keys in HSM + regional policy enforcement). Per-region HSM seats are optional if you want strict physical separation.

Commercial guardrails
- To deliver the full 15% add-on discount and amortized evidence credit, Redwood would look for a minimum committed ARR of $500,000 over 24 months (can be a blended hosted + Dedicated forecast). If the commit is 36 months, we can consider increasing to 18% and reduce amortization to 6 months.

Proposed next steps
1) If you agree to the $500k / 24-month floor we’ll update the term sheet and SOW acceptance criteria (I attached a 1-page evidence SOW and the evidence-fee-schedule).
2) We’ll also enumerate HSM-seat ramp milestones in the MAP and attach an invoice schedule for the pass-through attestation.
3) Optional: 30-min call with Ken + our legal ops to walk the SOW acceptance criteria tomorrow.

If this looks directionally good I’ll prepare a redline-friendly commercial sheet and a DocuSign package for procurement.

Thanks — Jordan
Senior AE | Redwood Inference

Jordan / Laura — quick internal note after reviewing the attached evidence-fee-schedule and pricing tiers:

- The split of $40k implementation / $20k pass-through looks reasonable. From a margin perspective we can absorb a 12% seat discount for the 24-month path but not the full 15% unless there is an elevated commit (>= $750k). Recommend we offer 12% on add-ons tied to a $500k / 24-month commit and hold 15% hostage for 36-months or $750k.
- For EU residency surcharge, OK to grant the proposed 10% regional reduction only if Starlite signs a data processing addendum (DPA) and an initial 12-month roadmap for region activation (so we don’t lose capacity in a half-rolled deployment).
- Require procurement to agree to pass-through billing for the third-party attestation line item (we don't want to carry that cash out).

If you want me to approve a commercial-sheet redline, Jordan, I can sign off on the 12% concession now and prepare an approval note for 15% if they move to 36 months.

Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
